title: Render-lane control descriptor (contract.md §4)
description: The render lane's PIXELS are binary (SceneFrame v1, §4.2) and never travel as JSON. What the control lane carries about the render lane is the screen.placement descriptor (§3.3, §4.4): which payload to read + generation to gate on. This schema validates that JSON descriptor plus the R0..R3 representation-rung tag. The binary SceneFrame v1 header layout is documented in scene_frame_v1.layout.json (structural, not JSON-Schema-checkable here).

lens_id.description: the lens this placement is for (screen.show reply, §3.3).

mode.description: negotiated placement (§5.2). Chosen by CAPABILITY, never front-end type (invariant 8).

scene_url.description: where the front-end reads the render payload: /scene.bin (R2 client-composite) or /frame.rgba | MJPEG (R3 server-composite) (§4.4).

generation.description: X-Phantom-Gen generation to gate on; an unchanged screen is never re-serialized (§4.4 felt-latency).

rung.description: representation rung (§4.1): R0 semantic / R1 scene / R2 surface(SceneFrame v1) / R3 encoded. DEFAULT is R0; pixels last.
